description: This file defines a Go package for Kubernetes client apply configurations related to the Node resource, including functions to construct, extract, and modify Node configurations for declarative management.

classes.name: NodeApplyConfiguration
classes.description: A declarative configuration for Kubernetes Node resource, supporting setting metadata, spec, and status fields, and methods for building and retrieving configuration details.

methods.name: Node
methods.description: Constructs a new NodeApplyConfiguration with specified name, defaulting kind to 'Node' and API version to 'v1'.

methods.name: ExtractNodeFrom
methods.description: Extracts a Node apply configuration from a Kubernetes corev1.Node object for a specific subresource, using managedfields.

methods.name: ExtractNode
methods.description: Extracts a Node apply configuration from a corev1.Node object for the main resource.

methods.name: ExtractNodeStatus
methods.description: Extracts a Node apply configuration from a corev1.Node object for the 'status' subresource.

methods.name: IsApplyConfiguration
methods.description: Indicates that this struct is an apply configuration.

methods.name: WithKind
methods.description: Sets the 'Kind' field in the configuration.

methods.name: WithAPIVersion
methods.description: Sets the 'APIVersion' field in the configuration.

methods.name: WithLabels
methods.description: Adds entries to the 'Labels' map in metadata.

methods.name: WithAnnotations
methods.description: Adds entries to the 'Annotations' map in metadata.

methods.name: WithOwnerReferences
methods.description: Adds owner references to the configuration.

methods.name: WithSpec
methods.description: Sets the 'Spec' field in the configuration.

methods.name: WithStatus
methods.description: Sets the 'Status' field in the configuration.
